name: Bracketed IPv6 literal with non-default port in both the URL and the Host header
spec_reference: #adcp-rfc-9421-profile (@authority derived from as-received Host; IPv6 brackets preserved, non-default port kept)
$comment: False-positive guard for negative/031. The Host header carries a well-formed bracketed IPv6 authority with a non-default port; it byte-matches the authority of the canonical @target-uri, so @authority is '[2001:db8::1]:8443' and the request verifies. Without this vector a verifier passes 031 by rejecting every Host header that contains ':' or '['. Extends 011-ipv6-authority (no Host header, default port) and 012 (default port stripped) to a non-default port carried on the Host header. Signature generated with the test-ed25519-2026 private key from expected_signature_base.
